reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is unchanged from the original paragraphs with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports the preferred position: Services are provided per 'specific engagement by Customer' under individual Exhibits (p0001) and the only economic term is a revenue share of amounts actually generated with pass-through payment (p0023) — no minimum spend, committed volume, or shortfall/penalty mechanic.
p0001 expressly disclaims exclusivity and preserves Customer's right to sell Inventory via other agents or third parties, so there is no volume cap or channel restriction on our party.

Rationale appropriately notes, rather than flags, adjacent items (Winning Bid Price floor set by Customer, one-year initial term exit limits, future Exhibit risk), consistent with the playbook's treatment of minor/non-material sub-elements.
